title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 618  An Act Converting the Eguia Barangay High School in the Municipality of Dasol, Province of Pangasinan, Into a National High School to Be Known as Eguia National High School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds therefor.

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Eguia Barangay tại Thị trấn Dasol, Tỉnh Pangasinan thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Eguia Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Eguia Barangay ในเทศบาล Dasol จังหวัด Pangasinan เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Eguia แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Eguia Barangay di Kotamadya Dasol, Provinsi Pangasinan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Eguia Nasional
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Eguia Barangay di Perbandaran Dasol, Wilayah Pangasinan kepada Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Eguia Kebangsaan

text.en:
The Eguia Barangay High School in the Municipality of Dasol, Province of Pangasinan, is
hereby converted into a national high school to be known as Eguia National High School.

The operation of said school for the current fiscal year shall continue to be funded out of local
funds and from its share of national aid to local schools. The requirements for succeeding fiscal years shall be
provided in the forthcoming General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 24, 1983
